retrofit.nomods.title: Retrofit: no 1.7.10 mods found
retrofit.nomods.text: Put 1.7.10 Forge mods in the mods folder (or retrofit/mods) and restart Minecraft.
retrofit.leftout.title: %s 1.7.10 mod(s) not loaded
retrofit.leftout.text: %s. The other mods are loaded; the log (logs/latest.log) has the details.
retrofit.mismatch.title: This server runs another version of Retrofit
retrofit.mismatch.version: Use the same version of Retrofit as the server.
retrofit.mismatch.mods:
This server's 1.7.10 mods differ from yours:

%s

The server's mods are needed here too, at versions they accept (compare Options > 1.7.10 Mods with the server's mods). Often it is a mod the server couldn't load: its log names each one ("1.7.10 mod not loaded"), and it has to be removed here too.

retrofit.otherversions.text: Not loaded, made for other Minecraft versions: %s
retrofit.download.title: Retrofit needs Minecraft 1.7.10
retrofit.download.intro: To run 1.7.10 mods, Retrofit needs Minecraft 1.7.10 and Forge 10.13.4.1614, which it does not include and your Minecraft launcher does not have. Retrofit can download them (%s) from their official sources:
retrofit.download.dependencies: Your 1.7.10 mods also want these mods, which they would otherwise try to download themselves (not checked by Retrofit):
retrofit.download.libraries: • %s libraries (%s), from Mojang (libraries.minecraft.net), Forge (maven.minecraftforge.net) or Maven Central (repo1.maven.org)
retrofit.download.where: The files are saved in %s. Retrofit sends nothing about you. Minecraft has to restart afterwards to load your 1.7.10 mods; until then they are not loaded.
retrofit.download.where.dependencies: They are saved in %s. Retrofit sends nothing about you. Minecraft has to restart afterwards to load your 1.7.10 mods. You can also download them from their mods' pages yourself and put them in retrofit/mods.
retrofit.download.never.info: Retrofit will not ask again. To change this, edit retrofit/retrofit.properties.
retrofit.download.done: Downloaded. Restart Minecraft to load your 1.7.10 mods.
retrofit.mods.title: 1.7.10 Mods
retrofit.mods.info.restart: 1.7.10 mods read most settings when Minecraft starts: restart it for your changes to apply.
retrofit.settings.title: Retrofit Settings
retrofit.settings.downloads.explanation: Retrofit runs 1.7.10 mods on Minecraft 1.7.10 and Forge 10.13.4.1614, which it does not include. When the Minecraft launcher does not have them, Retrofit downloads them from Mojang, Forge's Maven and Maven Central (and mods' dependencies from where the mods say), but only with permission. Ask: you are asked on the title screen. Yes: what is missing is downloaded when the game starts. Never: 1.7.10 mods load only when the files are already there.
